description: Runs the site's Customer Service Cost Calculator: from monthly tickets, handle time, agent cost, agents on staff, response time and after-hours share it estimates current and AI-assisted monthly cost, monthly and annual savings, tickets deflected, response-time reduction and ROI, with service recommendations. Use it for support-desk cost questions. An industry preset fills typical inputs.

afterHoursPercent.description: Percent of tickets arriving after hours (0 to 60)

avgHandleTime.description: Average handle time in minutes (2 to 30)

avgResponseTime.description: Average first response time in minutes (1 to 120)

industry.description: Optional preset; fills any input left out

name: estimate_customer_service_savings
title: Estimate customer service savings
